description: Lumped equilibrium-stage model of absorber and stripper columns for MEA-based post-combustion CO2 capture. First-principles thermodynamic model based on CO2-MEA equilibrium chemistry (Kent-Eisenberg simplified).
source: Kent, R.L. & Eisenberg, B. (1976). Hydrocarbon Processing, 55(2), 87-90; Abu-Zahra et al. (2007). Int. J. Greenhouse Gas Control, 1(1), 37-46.

unit.name: 30 wt% MEA Amine Scrubbing System — Equilibrium Stage

absorber_stages.note: Number of equilibrium stages in absorber

stripper_stages.note: Number of equilibrium stages in stripper

flue_gas_CO2_fraction.note: Mole fraction CO2 in flue gas (coal)

flue_gas_flow.note: Flue gas mass flow (500 MW coal plant)

VLE_A.note: Kent-Eisenberg VLE parameter A (fitted to MEA 30 wt%)

delta_H_abs.note: Heat of absorption of CO2 in MEA

Cp_solvent.note: Specific heat capacity of 30 wt% MEA solution

delta_H_vap_water.note: Latent heat of vaporization of water

steam_ratio.note: Steam lost per kg CO2 stripped

murphree_efficiency.note: Murphree stage efficiency (accounts for mass transfer limitations in packed column)

cross_hx_efficiency.note: Rich/lean cross-heat exchanger effectiveness (reduces sensible heat duty)
